## [PUBLIC] Scope

The startup-growth vertical holds management and growth skill flows: market scoring, resource optimization, founder outreach patterns, and related tactical manifests.

## [PUBLIC] Placement

Add skills under `mgmt-skills/` for **startup-specific execution flows**. Generic writing or QA skills belong in `core-operations/`. Board governance stays in `board/`.

## [PUBLIC] Constraints

- Domain execution flows in this vertical stay in the parent tree; this snapshot describes placement only.
- Flows MUST declare input requirements and output schema per skill-flow convention.
